text:
rachel: hitting a consistent hang on shutdown with our AsyncClient used as a module-level singleton + uvicorn --reload. Process sometimes doesn't exit, shows pending _refresh_task.
evan: can you share a tiny repro? is it httpx-based?
rachel: yes httpx. repro: import-time client starts refresh loop that awaits httpx. On SIGINT the loop shows CancelledError inside our retry/backoff and the refresher task stays pending.
sam: import-time startup + uvicorn reload is a known antipattern. We should offer a lifespan helper and explicit start/stop. Also typing: __aenter__ currently returns Any which makes `async with` awkward for users.
evan: plan: add client.start()/client.stop(), a lifespan() async contextmanager for FastAPI, make refresher watch an asyncio.Event, and change retry logic to not backoff on CancelledError so shutdown is cleaner.
ci-bot: Created issue #3827: "async client: graceful shutdown + lifecycle + typing" with repro attached.
rachel: thanks — will test patch on mac + linux with --reload. docs quickstart should show recommended ASGI pattern instead of import-time singletons.
